# The refund that settles a credit note: money going out, not coming in.
#
# `Assets:Bank:USD −100.00` against `Assets:Accounts Receivable USD +100.00`.
# The receivable split is positive because a credit note posts −100.00 there,
# and a settlement is what cancels the posting.
#
# Both sides are USD, so linking it converts nothing — which is exactly the
# path that takes the plain attach rather than the restatement, and so the one
# a sign guard reaches unconditionally.
#
# What this fixture produces: a USD transaction, bank −100.00 against a loose
# receivable split of +100.00.
#
# Verified by
# tests/integration/test_linking_a_split_not_on_the_receivable.py.
2026-03-18 * "Refund to the customer"
	guid: "beef0011beef0022beef0033beef0044"
	currency.mnemonic: "USD"
	Assets:Bank:USD -100.00 USD
		guid: "beef0055beef0066beef0077beef0088"
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
	Assets:Accounts Receivable USD 100.00 USD
		guid: "beef0099beef00aabeef00bbbeef00cc"
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
